purpose: Ensure execution-relevant ideas and discovered contract gaps leave chat as durable remote work state without duplicating existing plans or destabilizing active consumer migrations.
rules: Raw private idea text is not a public continuity artifact. Public receipts persist only semantic source identity, stable item handles, hashes, sanitized evidence references, and bounded work state.
Every execution-relevant idea must end the current agent turn with a durable remote anchor. CHAT_ONLY is not a valid completion state.
If an existing canonical plan is FOUND, CREATE_REMOTE_PLAN is forbidden; use that plan, add a bounded iteration when safe, or persist DEFERRED_ADOPTION.

When the target consumer is MIGRATION_ACTIVE or CONVERGENCE_ACTIVE and collision state is not CLEAR, mutation of that consumer is forbidden for this continuity transition; disposition must be DEFERRED_ADOPTION.
If canonical ownership is unresolved, do not guess. Persist BLOCKED_OWNER_RESOLUTION with a durable deferred anchor and an explicit owner-resolution next transition.
Operator priority is never inferred from chronology, timestamps, model judgment, frequency, or apparent urgency. Priority remains UNSPECIFIED unless explicitly supplied by the operator.
A disposition is continuity state, not implementation proof. Repository/provider implementation, merge, deployment, and production behavior require their own evidence.
